note: Round-2 proposals for Caracolina: names and looks only. No prices, nothing declared, nothing added to the game. The game has no cosmetics today; every item needs the game to build it.

store.name: Paper dove
store.look: A white paper dove, cut out and painted on both sides like the residents, that rides your traveller's shoulder and lifts off when you raise the lens.
store.reads_at_40: a white bird on a blue sky

store.name: Fisherman's beret
store.look: A cobalt beret for your paper traveller, drawn by the game's own people painter.
store.reads_at_40: a round blue hat on a face

store.name: Sea-glass tape
store.look: Washi tape in sea-glass green and blue for taping prints into your sketchbook.

store.name: Deckle edge
store.look: Your prints come out with a torn, deckled paper edge.
store.reads_at_40: a ragged white rectangle with a blue picture

store.name: Shell stamp
store.look: A small rubber stamp that presses an oxblood scallop shell onto a print.
store.reads_at_40: a stamp block beside its red shell print

owned_mark.look: A strip of washi tape slaps across the tile's lower-left corner and settles flat, the way prints are taped into the sketchbook. Under 900 ms; the held frame is the tape in place.

marker.look: A small print hanging from one strip of tape (next), and the same print taped flat (held).

rewards.name: Black egg sticker
rewards.look: A black egg, like the ones on the town's roofs, to stick on a print.

rewards.name: Lighthouse stamp
rewards.look: A postage stamp with the lighthouse on legs, for the postcards you send.

rewards.name: Chalk steps
rewards.look: A trail of chalk footprints behind your traveller.

rewards.name: Paper gull
rewards.look: A paper gull companion that circles over your traveller.

rewards.name: Sailor stripes
rewards.look: A striped top for your paper traveller.

rewards.name: Paper lantern
rewards.look: A paper lantern your traveller carries after dark.

rewards.name: Tidemark border
rewards.look: A sea-blue watercolour edge on your prints.

memberReward.name: Keeper's cap
memberReward.look: Tomàs's lighthouse-keeper's cap for your traveller.

update.change: The residents turn to face you when you talk to them.
update.look: Quim at his place in the garden of eyes at 19:48, turned square to the camera inside the eye-shaped door, the low sun beside him. (Planned as Remei; at that hour she stands in the great shell's shadow, so Quim shows the change in the poster's light.)

event.name: The Festival of the Shell
event.line: A week of festival nights: the whole town on the summit under fireworks.
event.shared_goal: Photographs of the fireworks, counted together. Target and dates: not decided.
event.look: The summit at festival night, fireworks over the sea in the right 55%, dark sky on the left.
